milestone: Validate the inherited named PE ledger replay without broadening its claim
context:
# Goal
Advisory audit of the inherited fleet round-1 saved PE ledger replay, baseline 286033c5f2b1683fb538e86e15667709bb49b054, work commit 7c3ce197341b0babe0046b1d9cbb59f1ba43f54e. Sole L1 owns integration and admission.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/revenger-shokunin. Each member may write only its assigned report. All implementation, SCORECARD, LOG, other reports, substrates, shared ledgers, configs and siblings are read-only. No commits, pushes, producer calls, package acquisition, external research, target execution, native session bodies, secrets or environment values. No delegation or background jobs. Skip every build, lint, test, formatter and smoke command mid-flight; L1 runs acceptance after integration. Distinguish static observations, inference and unknown; report exact source paths, bounded conclusions, risks, and an executable acceptance proposal, not invented outcomes. Existing author-side L2 evidence is not an independent spot-check. Native Rust judgment is not requested or implied. Historical r59 malformed-name refusal remains falsified/halted. Read only the assigned scope and directly relevant inputs.
# Routing prerequisite
Do not dispatch this payload unless existing global authority realizes content @m_composer, audit/review/scout/critic @m_grok, connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. Do not edit routes or silently substitute.
# Shared inputs
corpus/verify_named_multi_icon_states.py; corpus/fixtures/pe-r55 through pe-r57/fixture.exe; corpus/live/runs/round-55 through round-57/inspection.raw.json and receipt.json; reports/round-1/replay_scenarios.py. Relative paths are inside the sole writable repository.

items.name: PeHeader55
items.prompt: Audit only r55 PE32+ header and section-to-file mapping against decoder lines 16-26: machine, optional-header size, resource RVA/length, raw-section containment. Derive values independently from bytes; identify which assertions bound the authored fixture and which generic PE claims remain unsupported.

items.name: PeDirectories55
items.prompt: Audit only r55 resource-directory traversal against decoder lines 27-44: named/ID entry counts, directory lengths, cycle ancestry, three-level leaf shape, entry offsets. Independently enumerate directory paths and report exact byte locations and any unsupported malformed-tree claim.

items.name: PeUnicode55
items.prompt: Audit only the r55 supplementary-plane group-name identity: UTF-16LE length prefix, surrogate pair, spelling A😀B!, raw hex, location offset736/12. Compare byte-derived key with normalized resources[2].name and explain why this does not rehabilitate r59 malformed-name refusal.

items.name: PePayloads55
items.prompt: Audit only the three r55 payload data entries: independent RVA translation, declared ranges, code pages/reserved values, SHA-256 from bytes, and correspondence to saved normalized resources. Separate opaque payload integrity from image decoding.

items.name: PeGroup55
items.prompt: Audit only the valid r55 two-image RT_GROUP_ICON payload and ordered candidate links: header, 14-byte records, IDs1/2, candidate indices0/1, same-language match and declared-vs-actual sizes. Derive relations without using saved JSON as expected truth.

items.name: PeMissing56
items.prompt: Audit only r55-to-r56 selective missing-ID control: independently derive the sole byte928 02-to-03 change, verify preserved Unicode and all payloads, and derive first-link retention versus absent second candidate/null same-language/null size. Identify false-link risks.

items.name: PeSize57
items.prompt: Audit only r55-to-r57 selective size control: independently derive sole byte924 30-to-2f change, preserved IDs/payloads/name, and derive retained candidates with second size_matches false. Explain the boundary between a size relation and image validity.

items.name: ReplayLocalReads
items.prompt: Audit only local-read ownership in the changed verifier: trace ROOT, fixture reads, report/receipt reads and HIST uses through check/main/compare_normalized. Determine whether any historical-root filesystem access or cwd-dependent input lookup remains; no filesystem probes outside the lane.

items.name: ReplayArtifactPin
items.prompt: Audit only normalized_result.artifact.path expected identity: compare baseline and work constructor, independent HIST authority in brief/LOG versus saved field, exact path equality, and relocated-path laundering. Assess whether expected values can be controlled by the data under test.

items.name: ReplayCommandPin
items.prompt: Audit only receipt.command identity after cutover: historical path interpolation, package version/subcommand/format spelling, agreement for r55-r57, and rejection mechanism for a relocated command. Do not execute npx or claim producer authenticity.

items.name: ReplayReceipt55
items.prompt: Audit only r55 receipt internal consistency: fixture/evidence/exit/duration fields and SHA-256 of complete raw stdout bytes. Enumerate checked and unchecked receipt properties and distinguish consistency from producer authentication.

items.name: ReplayReceipt56
items.prompt: Audit only r56 receipt and the missing-link record's identity: pinned EID, fixture digest, full raw stdout digest, operation and subject digest. Check whether the missing-link control could be accepted under another record's identity; cite exact conditions.

items.name: ReplayReceipt57
items.prompt: Audit only r57 receipt and size-mismatch record identity: pinned EID/digests, raw-byte hashing versus reserialized JSON, and command/duration checks. Determine what byte-preserving receipt checks establish and which origin facts remain unknown.

items.name: ReplayEnvelopeLimits
items.prompt: Audit only saved Evidence envelope fields not covered by normalized-result equality: parameters.path, locations paths, subject/operation and ancillary metadata. Inventory which can change without rejection from static code, and propose a separate future criterion without editing scope or claiming rejection now.

items.name: ReplayWholeNormalized
items.prompt: Audit only complete normalized-dictionary equality before/after the HIST cutover: enumerate expected top-level keys, directories/resources/icon_groups/coverage/limitations and whether any field was dropped, copied from saved output, or weakened. Preserve authored-fixture scope.

items.name: ReplayBuiltinMutants
items.prompt: Audit only main's two in-memory forged-claim controls and their new HIST arguments: positive-before-negative ordering, non-noop mutation, expected normalized-result assertion and possible unrelated-rejection masking. Do not run mutations; propose observable L1 checks.

items.name: ScenarioLaneRoot
items.prompt: Audit only acceptance scenario P1 lane-root CLI: script/cwd resolution, actual subprocess invocation, success predicate, timeout and diagnostic extraction. Determine whether it exercises the shipped verifier rather than imports, mocks or an alternate implementation.

items.name: ScenarioForeignCwd
items.prompt: Audit only P2 unrelated-CWD scenario: distinguish absolute script path from cwd, confirm local files resolve from __file__, and identify whether prior shell state could accidentally provide the historical tree. Propose the exact L1 observable for cwd independence.

items.name: ScenarioUnicodeCopy
items.prompt: Audit only P3 minimal copied corpus under spaces/non-ASCII: completeness of staged files, Unicode path handling without shell interpolation, script preservation and historical identity invariance. Identify ways a copy might pass without reading copied inputs.

items.name: ScenarioArtifactForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N1 normalized artifact-path forgery: declared single-field diff, unmodified EID, rehashed raw stdout receipt, positive counterpart and expected r55 artifact refusal. Assess whether failure can be attributed to historical-identity checking rather than raw hash mismatch.

items.name: ScenarioCommandForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N2 receipt-command forgery: original command precondition, relocated path substitution, exact changed-field ledger and raw stdout unchanged. Assess the exit1/r55 receipt oracle and whether incidental changes could hide a weakened command check.

items.name: ScenarioCandidateForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N3 r56 second-candidate forgery: mutation from [] to [1], single-field evidence, receipt stdout rehash, unchanged fixture and expected full-normalized refusal. Evaluate preservation of the valid first link and missing-link semantics.

items.name: ScenarioSizeForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N4 r57 second size_matches forgery: false-to-true mutation, exact nested path, no fixture change, rehashed receipt and expected normalized-result finding. Assess whether an independent consumer-visible size assertion is being exercised.

items.name: ScenarioNameLocationForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N5 Unicode-name location forgery: offset736-to-700 while length/name/hex stay unchanged, exact diff check, rehashed stdout and byte-derived expected location. Determine whether the decoder derives location independently rather than echoing saved data.

items.name: ScenarioEntryLocationForgery
items.prompt: Audit only N6 ancestor-entry location forgery: offset536-to-520 at resources[2].entry_locations[0], exact diff check and rehashed stdout. Trace how decoder constructs ancestor locations and whether this protects the saved named resource's route.

items.name: ScenarioIsolationSafety
items.prompt: Audit only acceptance-runner filesystem and subprocess safety: temp-tree creation/deletion, no original input writes, timeout/error paths, --keep-temp implications and cleanup verdict. No execution; flag any possibility of out-of-scope write or secret/session capture.

items.name: InputPreservationLedger
items.prompt: Produce only an advisory preservation ledger from the already saved input-ledger files and r55-r57 source pointers: required nine input paths plus verifier pin, which baseline hashes need L1 remeasurement, and how to avoid treating rewritten/rehashed evidence as preserved history. No code changes or gate execution.

items.name: ReplayScoreCalibration
items.prompt: Audit only calibration proxy arithmetic and interpretation in SCORECARD/current brief: exact four-script set, 1/4-to-2/4 scope, overlap with 7/10-to-8/10 census, selected-script self-test flag behavior, and measurement-commit binding. Flag unsupported general mastery or admission implications.

items.name: ReplayCoverageTaxonomy
items.prompt: Audit only coverage's fixed eight-family saved-record-presence taxonomy: inspect recorded operation names and F counting command, EVM's inherited omission, 4/8 constancy and difference between record presence and producer readiness. Do not acquire new family evidence or rerun known failed gates.

items.name: ReplayHistoryErrata
items.prompt: Audit only chronology and append-only obligations: imported r59 falsification/halt, r60 distinct coverage move, new fleet round1 versus launch count, existing work commit and unlanded reports. Identify which claims must remain historical/debt rather than rewritten as contemporary passes.

items.name: ReplayContinuationContract
items.prompt: Audit only fresh-session continuation and completion prerequisites against current dispatch: exact round identity, required width32 evidence, no in-session round loop, applicable receipt and report durability, no-push scope, and honest unavailable-route handling. Return concrete closure blockers, not a completion verdict.

items.name: ReplayCrossAxisConnector
items.prompt: Connect only this round's local-vs-historical identity split to calibration and coverage boundaries: synthesize how immutable provenance plus relocatable reads affects forgeries and reproducibility; identify one compatible lesson and one bounded counterexample using unchecked envelope fields. Keep r59 policy halted; no extra implementation or new axis claim.
